cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_build.head: Build the Industrial Furnace
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_build.text: The industrial furnace is a 3x3x3 block structure
In the middle, 1 furnace on each side
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_connection: Fill water into the water type ports
Fill fuel into the fuel type ports
Drain hot water from the output type ports
Connect the mechanical port to a rotational source
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_use.text_1: Right-click on a furnace while holding an item that can be smelted
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_use.text_2: The item is smelted 4 times faster
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_use.text_3: Shift right-click again to get the result
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_use.text_4: This consumes fuel and water, and returns hot water
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_use.text_5: You must preheat the furnace before using it
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_utils.head: Utilities of the Industrial Furnace
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_utils.text: Use a bell to hear a sound signal when an item is smelted or when the industrial furnace is at risk of exploding
Use redstone power to start the industrial furnace (preheating)
If you don't drain the hot water or don't fill it with water, the industrial furnace will explode
cif.ponder.cif_fluid_port_changetype.hea: Change the Type of Fluid Port
cif.ponder.cif_fluid_port_changetype.tex: You can change the type of a fluid port with a right-click using a wrench
You can drain fluid from an output type, but you can't fill it
You can fill fluid into a water type, but you can't drain it
You can fill fluid into a fuel type, but you can't drain it
cif.ponder.cif_furnace_ponder_automate.t: You can automate the Industrial Furnace
You can interact with the funnel or with a hopper
cif.ponder.furnace_change_view.text_1: You can change the view mode with a right-click using a wrench
cif.ponder.portable_tank_use.text_1: You can put all types of fluid in a portable tank
cif.ponder.portable_tank_use.text_2: The fluid is kept when broken
cif.ponder.portable_tank_use.text_3: A portable tank can be filled by a spout
cif.ponder.portable_tank_use.text_4: A portable tank can be drained by the item drain
cif.ponder.portable_tank_use.text_5: You can fill a portable tank with a mechanical pump
cif.ponder.portable_tank_use.text_6: You can drain a portable tank with a mechanical pump
cif.ponder.cif_goggles_about.text_1: All block information from the mod can be viewed with goggles
cif.ponder.cif_goggles_about.text_5: Current Type, information about the type
cif.ponder.cif_chemical_cleaner_use.head: Using the Chemical Cleaner
cif.ponder.cif_chemical_cleaner_use.text: The chemical cleaner transforms hot water into regular water
You can insert activated carbon into the chemical cleaner with a right-click
You can remove activated carbon from the chemical cleaner with shift + right-click
The output side has red pixels, and the input side has blue ones
cif.ponder.control_panel_usage.text_1: The control panel allows you to view the contents of the furnace slots
cif.ponder.control_panel_change_view.hea: Change the view of the control panel
cif.ponder.control_panel_change_view.tex: To change the view type (input slots, output slots, or empty), right-click the control panel with a wrench
